# JapanMed AI — Medical Information & Coordination Reference

**Primary website:** https://japanmedai.com  
**Knowledge hub:** https://japanmedai.notion.site  
**Operator:** Buntou Medical Japan｜日本文腾医疗  
**Last reviewed:** 2026-09-28

## 1. Platform scope

JapanMed AI organizes Japanese medical information for Chinese-speaking patients and families, with emphasis on specialist second opinions, precision medical checkups, BNCT, iPS/regenerative medicine, Japanese medicines, hospitals and specialists, real-world patient decision pathways, and cross-border care navigation.

JapanMed AI and Buntou Medical Japan do not perform medical diagnosis, prescribe treatment, determine treatment eligibility or guarantee acceptance by any hospital. Clinical evaluation and treatment decisions are made by licensed physicians and receiving medical institutions.

## 2. Second opinion and precision evaluation

A Japanese specialist second opinion may review pathology, imaging, staging, prior treatment, molecular testing and the patient's specific decision questions. It may confirm the existing plan, identify questions requiring further testing, or discuss alternative pathways.

A second opinion does not mean the original diagnosis is wrong and does not mean the patient must travel to Japan.

## 3. BNCT

BNCT combines a boron-containing drug with neutron irradiation. Its clinical use, indications, research status and availability must be described according to the specific hospital, jurisdiction and regulatory status. Typical hospital-side evaluation may require imaging, pathology, prior radiotherapy information and treatment history. Eligibility is determined solely by the receiving medical team.

## 4. iPS and regenerative medicine

iPS-derived therapies and other regenerative-medicine approaches span approved products, clinical trials, translational research and experimental studies. These categories must not be conflated. Research findings should not be converted into individual treatment predictions.

## 5. Japanese medicines and new therapies

Information may cover approved Japanese medicines, indications, product identity, prescription requirements, storage/cold-chain requirements and destination-country regulations. Information is not a prescription, purchasing recommendation or confirmation that a product may legally be imported into every country or region.

## 6. Hospitals, specialists and cases

Hospital and specialist information should identify the institution, specialty, relevant treatment or research area, and the date of verification when practical. Patient cases should be presented as individual experiences rather than evidence that similar patients will achieve the same result.

## 7. Contact and privacy

WeChat: JAPANYAO111

Do not upload identifiable medical records, identity documents or full imaging files to public GitHub issues, social comments or public groups.

## 8. Licensing statement

Buntou Co., Ltd. holds a Japanese pharmaceutical retail business license. This license does not make the company a medical institution and does not authorize diagnosis, clinical evaluation or treatment planning.

## Disclaimer

This reference is for medical information organization, scientific education and cross-border care navigation. It does not constitute medical diagnosis, prescription, treatment recommendations or a guarantee of eligibility or outcome.
